title: Boston-based software monitoring startup Coralogix raised a $200M Series F at a $1.6B post-money valuation, up from $1B+ after a $115M Series E in June 2025 (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Boston-based software monitoring startup Coralogix raised a $200M Series F at a $1.6B post-money valuation, up from $1B+ after a $115M Series E in June 2025 — Coralogix, a Boston-headquartered software monitoring startup founded in Israel, has raised $200 million in a new funding round …
